set.body: Replace the stale broad operation matrix under the hardened protocol, implement a semantics-preserving physical traversal for reversed injective mutable views if confirmed, and extend the standalone SIMD probe to extrema and fixed-width reductions. Acceptance: parity before timing; same-host JMH and GC where relevant; JVM/Scala.js tests; no core Vector API dependency; exact NaN, signed-zero, wraparound, and pairwise contracts; record noisy or rejected experiments.
